svg.text: Material: 4.0mm Aluminum Disk (Dia. 200 mm / 7.87") | 3-Cell 120° Triad (6 Holes) | Page: A4

g.text: 1. Print at 100% scale (no fit/shrink to page).
2. Verify scale using calibration ruler on right.
3. Center punch and drill 6 holes total (3 pairs).

svg.text: 1:1 SCALE VERIFICATION RULER (DO NOT SCALE / FIT TO PAGE)
